title: 口语练习
subtitle: 每天 10 分钟 · 共 5 天
steps: 点 🔊 听一遍，听清语调
一句一句跟着读，声音要大，不怕错
读完点「今天完成了」打卡

sentences.en: What is the difference between you and your sister?
sentences.zh: 你和你姐姐有什么不同？

sentences.en: She is outgoing, but I am a little shy.
sentences.zh: 她很外向，但我有点害羞。

sentences.en: We have a lot in common.
Both of us like music and play the flute.
sentences.zh: 我们俩都喜欢音乐，都吹长笛。

sentences.en: I am as tall as my brother.
What do you do in your spare time?
A good friend will always lend you a hand.
sentences.zh: 好朋友总会助你一臂之力。

sentences.en: We are different, but we are still good friends.
sentences.zh: 我们虽然不同，但仍是好朋友。
